LM.invalid: Nonfinite loss, negative count or missing target contract fails channel; nonpositive total valid targets is INVALID_ZERO_TARGETS; never divide by zero
LM.output: Actual qualified next-token LM head; not hidden-layer or classifier loss
LM.overflow: Keep finite NLL/logPPL; set overflowing PPL=null with OVERFLOW reason, no clamp or silent infinity
LM.resampling: For each paired sampled group multiplicity, recompute token-weighted corpus NLL and then exp; do not average per-sequence PPL

metrics.accuracy: Binary p(class1)>=0.5; splice argmax with sorted numeric class order
metrics.auroc: Binary class1; splice unweighted macro one-vs-rest sorted class order
metrics.average_precision: Binary class1; splice arithmetic mean of per-class one-vs-rest AP
metrics.classification_cross_entropy: sklearn log_loss from float64 probabilities, natural logs; class-aligned and clipped to float64 machine epsilon in bootstrap; distinct from LM
metrics.primary_designation: Prospective B05 reaffirmation of explicit B03 COHORT_RECEIPT.primary_classification_metric; historical protocol lists alone do not establish a confirmatory primary hypothesis
metrics.probability_validation: Exact ID/class alignment, finite float64 probabilities, entries in[0,1], row sums validated by pinned source
metrics.units: AUROC/AP/accuracy/balanced accuracy reported as fractions; deltas in fraction units; CE/NLL in nats, PPL dimensionless; no undocumented percentage-point conversion

numeric_audit_tolerances.scope: Separate native versus probability/statistical gates; never interchanged or relaxed

probe.classifier: L2 balanced LogisticRegression, LBFGS, tol1e-4, optimizer random_state42
probe.feature_reuse: Extract once per model/population for all26 coordinates; reuse across all CV seeds
probe.fold_aggregation: Unweighted arithmetic mean of each fold AUROC, not pooled OOF AUC or sample-size-weighted mean
probe.fold_policy: Reuse exact saved task/seed StratifiedGroupKFold partitions, three H3 folds/five other-task folds; no regeneration
probe.retry: Fresh identical fit at10000 only after ConvergenceWarning; record all warnings/iterations/times; unresolved convergence or other final warnings block cell, no alternative C/solver/folds/tolerance/sample substitution
probe.scaling: Fit StandardScaler only on each fold training rows; final scaler/head refitted on all authorized task training rows after C selection
probe.selection_metric: Training-CV AUROC; binary class1; splice sorted0/1/2 macro-OVR
probe.tie_break: Exact equality of mean score; max(mean_AUROC,-C), hence smaller C; no isclose tie band

uncertainty.LM_validity: Require positive sampled target denominator; LM does not reject a draw merely for missing a classification class

uncertainty.classification_validity: All numeric classes have positive sampled support; identical label-based valid mask across paired endpoints/policies; record valid/invalid counts; no valid draws -> interval unavailable with reason
uncertainty.draw_semantics: Exactly2000 attempted group draws; missing-class draws marked invalid, never redrawn until2000 valid

uncertainty.group: SHA256 of lexicographically smaller canonical uppercaseACGTN sequence and reverse complement; not min of two hashes
uncertainty.group_order: np.unique sorted group names; default_rng(seed).integers with int32 matrix(2000,n_groups)
uncertainty.interval: np.quantile of paired raw metric differences on valid draws at[0.025,0.975], default linear interpolation; fixed fitted heads
